name: @genoffice/diagram
description: Diagram editor module: hosts the draw.io editor offline in a shell tab to open, edit, save and export .drawio diagrams

scripts.dev: node ../../vendor/drawio/prepare.mjs && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts && electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:renderer: node ../../vendor/drawio/prepare.mjs && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts && vite --config vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.build: electron-vite build && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts && node ../../vendor/drawio/prepare.mjs

author: GenOffice
